description: This file defines the class HonoChainAuthHandler, which extends ChainAuthHandlerImpl. It customizes the error handling for authentication failures by overriding the processException method to delegate exception processing to AuthHandlerTools. It serves as a specialized authentication handler within the Hono service’s HTTP layer, integrating with Vert.x web framework.

classes.name: HonoChainAuthHandler
classes.description: A Hono-specific extension of the Vert.x ChainAuthHandlerImpl that handles authentication exceptions by delegating to AuthHandlerTools for proper processing.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Overrides the method to delegate exception processing to AuthHandlerTools, ensuring correct handling of authentication errors.
